run_calc_metrics_cli: run the calc_metrics CLI to calculate FID and other quality metrics for a trained network pickle
run_subprocess_fn: run the subprocess_fn to initialize distributed training and calculate metrics on a specific GPU rank
create_CommaSeparatedList: create a CommaSeparatedList Click ParamType to parse comma-separated metric names from CLI arguments
test_calc_metrics: test the calc_metrics function by running FID50k evaluation on a pretrained StyleGAN2 network pickle
review_subprocess_fn: review the subprocess_fn to understand how it initializes torch.distributed and calculates metrics across GPUs
